name: radar-emploi-nature-mobile
description: Application Android et iOS de Radar Emploi Nature (Capacitor).

scripts.android: npm run www && (test -d android || npx cap add android) && npx capacitor-assets generate --android && python3 harden_android.py && npx cap sync android
scripts.ios: npm run www && (test -d ios || npx cap add ios) && npx capacitor-assets generate --ios && npx cap sync ios
scripts.apk: npm run android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
